## About
Asia Works was started to give Honda and Acura owners honest, competent repair work at a good value. Our name has changed, but the way we work hasn't. We know most of our customers by name, and we give each one our full attention.
Our staff brings ASE certifications and previous factory training to every job. We will never sell you a repair your car doesn't need, and our technicians are always happy to answer your questions.
Neighbors have rated us 4.9 from 139 Google reviews. We serve drivers across Charlotte and Mecklenburg, Union, and Cabarrus Counties.

## Services
- Scheduled vehicle maintenance: Keep up with your car's maintenance schedule to head off problems before they start.
- Diagnostic testing: We track down what's wrong before we recommend a fix.
- Engine repair
- Transmission repair
- Air conditioning repair and maintenance
- Emissions testing and repair
- Suspension services
- Chassis service

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on cars other than Honda and Acura?
A: For other Japanese models, give us a call and we'll talk it through.

Q: How do appointments work?
A: Call us and we'll set you up with an appointment day. Bring your car by the evening before or when we open that morning.

Q: What kind of parts do you use?
A: We use Genuine Honda parts or parts made by their vendors, and when it makes sense we'll suggest used parts as an alternative to new to save you money.

Q: What days are you open?
A: We're open Tuesday through Saturday and closed Sunday and Monday.
